profile.headline: Software Engineer at Soberlink
profile.summary: As a software engineer, I believe in putting thought and care into creating software in order to deliver the best product to clients in order to improve their lives. I am looking to continue to improve upon my skills while building great products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full stack development for clients such as the County of Ventura and TenXTL
• ASP .Net Core Fullstack development of websites and server applications utilizing complex data structures. 
• Utilized front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create intuitive user interfaces.
• Implemented Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL Database for seamless application deployment and data management.
• Continuously improved application performance through performance profiling, optimization, and caching techniques.
• Create and manage a scalable SQL database to handle and process millions of utility and emission data.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET Core · Microsoft Azure · HTML · Web Development

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Successfully expanded and maintained critical software manufacturing tools that manage firmware
and validate that storage products meet consumer requirements.
• Led the unification between manufacturing testing tools and an external LED analysis device that was
incorporated into the essential storage product assembly process.
• Worked across time zones to ensure that the manufacturing tools were operating at required efficiency
and accuracy to identify faulty Solid State Drives.
• Managed software requests and expectations from various hard drive factories across the globe.
• Developed application that was designed to be effortlessly operated by users of all skill level.
• Incorporated changes in customer needs and requirements into application rapidly and in a timely
manner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Core Geospatial and Data Processing features of Web Based DoD Security Application
“Localīz” in an Agile DevOps environment.
• Created a Realtime alert system for possible security threats based on user devices, geo-location, and
their persona profiles.
• Drafted and executed the Architectural data flow chart that defined the server to client implementation
of “Localīz.”
• Implemented Microsoft Azure Functions service allowing sensor data to be consistently processed and
displayed across all connected web applications.
• Converted relational SQL data into a user-friendly interface by implementing CRUD operational tables.

Localīz
•	Geospatial Web-Based application designed to enhance DoD base security operations.
•	Provides a more efficient method to monitor Realtime geo-locations of user devices within defined geofenced areas of interest
•	Realtime base security alert service utilizing Microsoft’s SignalR Engine.
•	Employed Azure Geo-Mapping to identify perimeter breaches within a base
•	Awarded $1.5M from US Air Force during the “Base of the Future” DoD event

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a data analysis software for use with data collected for the Arctic-Boreal Vulnerability Experiment (ABoVE)
• Collaborated with researchers internationally that specialize in the Arctic regions as part of the NASA ABoVE project
• Presented research at the American Geophysical Union in December 2019
• Utilized the NCCS “Discover” supercomputing cluster to use in conjunction with data analysis

Model–Data Integration Framework (MoDIF)
• Data analysis tool that calculates and graphs the correlations and regressions for hundreds of studies in the Arctic and Boreal regions
• Designed using python in conjunction with NASA Center for Climate Simulation’s cloud computing resources
• Demonstrate the impact of how these data and relationships can be used to improve two ESM land models—CLM and ELM.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented utility to monitor and export system and user event logs over network interface.
• Performed query analysis and profiling to resolve performance bottlenecks
